entities.summary: Emma Olivia Chapman is a British physicist and Royal Society Dorothy Hodgkin Research Fellow at University of Nottingham. Her research investigates the epoch of reionization. She won the 2018 Royal Society Athena Prize. In November 2020 Chapman published her first book, First Light: Switching on Stars at the Dawn of Time.
